title: Implement a raw project-graph ring-direction candidate for IFX C1
goal: Cover V3-style raw direct and transitive ring direction without claiming import, ownership or compiled equivalence.
acceptanceCriteria: A hashed public-contract module applies the exact V3 ring, allowed-dependency and transitive-boundary projection to raw src entry projects and their bounded references.
Direct, transitive, flow-boundary, clean, malformed, unsafe, missing and zero-match fixtures assert deterministic evidence and TargetRoot invariance.
Real IFX candidate scan, synthetic published-Host Pre, isolated IFX package test, unchanged Package hash and Formal Pre/Diff pass.
No production Profile, bundle acceptance or complete L2.2/C1 claim is made.
